title: 美联储前主席：9月加息不是坏主意，市场在赌什么？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: What's the role of the Fed in all of this? That's the important question for you, sir.
segments.zh: 美联储在其中扮演什么角色？这是您面临的重要问题。

segments.en: Does the Fed have a role to play here to help stabilize this bond market?
segments.zh: 美联储是否应该发挥作用来帮助稳定债券市场？

segments.en: Oh, absolutely. I think that the fact that the committee is projecting Core PC to be above 3% at the end of this year, that would be the same as in 2023, 2024, 2025, and now 2026.
segments.zh: 当然。委员会预计今年年底核心PCE将高于3%，这与2023年、2024年、2025年以及现在的2026年相同。

segments.en: So that looks like a 3% inflation target. They have to take action to convince markets that they really want to get inflation back down to 2%, and Chairman Washington did a good job in
segments.zh: 所以这看起来像是3%的通胀目标。他们必须采取行动让市场相信他们真的想让通胀回到2%，而华盛顿主席在表示这是他的目标方面做得很好。

segments.en: saying that that's what he wants to do, but the market is going to want to see action.
segments.zh: 但市场希望看到实际行动。

segments.en: And why not take action? GDP now for the third quarter, you know, up at 4%, you've got
segments.zh: 为什么不采取行动呢？现在第三季度GDP增长高达4%，而且

segments.en: equity or, let's say, wealth to disposable income ratio at all time highs. That's feeling
segments.zh: 财富与可支配收入之比处于历史高位，这正在推动消费，失业率很低，初请失业金人数也很低。

segments.en: ongoing consumption, unemployment rate, very low claims, initial claims very low.
segments.zh: 所以看起来劳动力市场表现良好。因此，现在是重建抗通胀信誉的好时机，并且继续采取行动。

segments.en: So it looks like you have a good labor market. So it's a good time to reestablish credibility on inflation fighting, and go ahead and make a move. You probably wouldn't have to do too much now,
segments.zh: 现在可能不需要做太多，

segments.en: and then that'll save you from a headache that you might develop for 2027.
segments.zh: 这样就能避免2027年可能出现的麻烦。

segments.en: So are you saying that they should hike in September?
segments.zh: 所以你是说他们应该在九月加息吗？
